texts.name: Wyrm
texts.biography: After his defeat during the assault on Noraston, Wyrm was forced to leave Enroth with his brother Rialdo. They decided to go to Deyja the land of the vampires , where a new king had just been autoproclaimed...

specialty.description: Casts Slayer with effect increased by 20 for level 1–2 creatures, by 16 for level 3–4 creatures, by 12 for level 5–6 creatures, and by 8 for level 7 creatures.
specialty.name: Slayer
